title: New Update Available (v1.0.3+16)
message: Fixed student delete & fee sync, 32-bit (v7) installer error fix, hardware ABI detection, and cloud database cleanup.
releaseNotes:
• Fixed student deletion so deleted students never reappear as blank ghost records
• Fixed 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) installation & update error with accurate hardware ABI detection
• Updated download redirects and release mirrors
• General performance and cloud synchronization improvements
